themes_negative: isolated Google complaint of aggressive/intimidating instructor behaviour (older, likely the male instructor Richard)
review_summary: On the independent, verified klantenvertellen platform (96 reviews, 9.9/10, 100% recommend, fresh into 2026) students consistently praise instructrice 'Avalon' for being calm, patient and personal, especially helping learners with faalangst, stress or concentration problems pass — often first time. The main negative note is an older Google one-star review describing aggressive/intimidating behaviour from a male instructor (Richard), plus a below-average CBR pass rate.
red_flags: Reviews split across two apparent personas: verified klantenvertellen praises female instructor 'Avalon' (clearly tied to autorijschool-avalon.nl), while Google/rijloket/trustoo conflate a related 'Rijschool Avalon' Uden listing with male instructor 'Richard' who has one strongly negative review.

klantenvertellen reviews are uniformly glowing (almost all 10/10) and many come from the same nearby towns (Uden/Volkel), but they are verified, specific, dated and substantive, so not flagged as fake.
Google sample is very small (~6 reviews) so the negative outlier carries limited statistical weight.
